By Web Desk -
Sep 26, 2026

India all-rounder Hardik Pandya’s return to competitive cricket has suffered another setback after he was ruled out of the upcoming 50-over matches against Australia A due to a fresh shin injury, according to a report by ESPNcricinfo. [1]

Hardik initially suffered back spasms during the IPL before sustaining a leg strain at the CoE ahead of India’s ODI series against Afghanistan in June. [1]
